summary: Tennis tournament Tennis tournament 2021 Copa LP Chile Date 8–14 November 2021 Edition 4th Category ITF Women's World Tennis Tour Prize money $60,000+H Surface Clay / Outdoor Location Santiago , Chile Champions Singles Anna Bondár Doubles Arianne Hartono / Olivia Tjandramulia ← 2019 · Copa LP Chile · 2022 → The 2021 Copa LP Chile was a professional women's tennis tournament played on outdoor clay courts . It was the fourth edition of the tournament which was part of the 2021 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour . It took place in Santiago , Chile between 8 and 14 November 2021.
